summary: No aerial or recent elevated photo on Commons. Day: 2006 view from high in the stands with the field filling most of the frame. No night photo.

files.author: B (Commons user)

files.note: From the upper stands looking down on play near midfield, opposite stands and crowd across the top third; field fills the lower two thirds, roughly rows 430-1200. Only 1600x1200; predates the 2008 Deacon Tower on the press-box side, which is not in frame. Late-afternoon light.

closest_misses.why: 2004 pregame from the grass berm; low angle with fans in the foreground.
